problems: Labels collide: 'head of the sail' overlaps 'top of the sail's curved belly'; 'outermost bulge of the full sail' overlaps 'lower belly of the sail'; 'bow of the hull' overlaps 'hull, foot of the mast' and 'stern of the hull, upper edge' sits on top of the stern tip label.
Several labels are clipped at the frame or over the drawing, e.g. 'masthead, the top of the mas' and 'clew, the bottom outer corne' are cut off.
The hull is tiny and flat (roughly x 285-341, y 465-470), a thin sliver under a very tall sail, so the stern and bow stars are crowded into a few pixels.

The gold outline is a straight-edged polygon while the blue underlay is a curved sail silhouette. The two are offset, so the sail edge reads as doubled in places, especially the belly between the curved top and the clew.
Lower belly star 100310 sits inside the cloth near the outer bulge, which is acceptable but close to the outermost bulge star 100064, so the two parts are hard to tell apart.
output.advice: Keep the figure. It is upright (mast top at y~108, hull and waves at y~465-505) and reads as a sailboat with a single tall sail.
